name: DynaMath
intro: DynaMath是一个动态视觉数学基准，旨在深入评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的数学推理鲁棒性。该基准包含501个高质量、多主题的种子问题，每个问题都以Python程序表示，通过精心设计和标注，可以自动生成大量具体的变体问题。DynaMath通过评估VLM在不同输入条件下的表现，来衡量其泛化能力，揭示了当前VLM在数学推理方面的局限性。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, UC Berkeley
build_method: 视觉数学题筛选, STEM学生策略标注, Python程序化生成, 人工程序质检
metric: Average-case Accuracy (Aavg), Worst-case Accuracy (Awst), Reasoning Robustness (RR), Repetition Consistency (RC)
eval_feature: 动态视觉与文本变体, 平均与最坏性能对照, 重复一致性
scale: 501个种子程序, 每题10个评测变体, 共5,010个具体问题
build_method_en: Visual-math seed curation, STEM-student strategy annotation, Python program generation, manual program QA
eval_feature_en: Dynamic visual and textual variants, average-versus-worst performance, repetition consistency
intro_en: DynaMath is a dynamic visual math benchmark designed to thoroughly evaluate the mathematical reasoning robustness of visual language models (VLMs). It contains 501 high-quality, multi-topic seed problems, each represented as a Python program. Through careful design and annotation, a large number of specific variant problems can be automatically generated. DynaMath measures VLMs' generalization ability by assessing their performance under different input conditions, revealing current limitations in VLMs' mathematical reasoning.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with DynaMath arXiv:2411.00836 / ICLR 2025 Sections 3.1–3.3, Figures 2–4, and Table 1. The diagram records the corrected source counts: MathVista 107, MATH-V 27, 45 scientific-figure plus 48 graph-theory items from MMMU/materials, 236 public-web questions, and 38 author-designed questions; review against overly complex images; college STEM students annotating solution strategies; 501 Python seed programs; seven variation families; 470 plotting and 31 fixed-image programs; manual program QA; ten sampled variants per seed for 5,010 questions; prompt/template short-answer extraction; Aavg; Awst requiring all ten variants correct; RR = Awst/Aavg; and five-repeat RC analysis.
